basic_details.job_title: JNTUK Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY), Govt. of India sponsored project "AI-Driven Solution for Autonomous Cybersecurity Threat Detection, Analysis and Mitigation" at University College of Engineering (A), Kakinada, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Kakinada (JNTUK) has re-advertised one Administrative Assistant post. The position is purely temporary and coterminous with the project tenure, with emoluments of Rs. 18,000/- + HRA per month. Graduates in any discipline with proven computer proficiency can apply by filling the online form by 30-11-2026, 5:00 PM.

how_to_apply: Fill the application form at the Google Form link given in the notice (https://forms.gle/DmRUERMFNVR5SpA9A).
Attach a detailed CV, maximum 3 to 4 pages, specifying your qualifications and experience.
Attach scanned copies of your experience certificate and marksheets from class X till date.
For any queries, the notice asks candidates to send a mail to [email protected].
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for an interview. Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail only. Originals of degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) must be brought to the interview.

content_sections.heading: JNTUK Administrative Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY), Govt. of India

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists these required skills for the post: MS Office, spreadsheet management, and document formatting Handling official correspondence and maintaining project records Handling procurement documentation, file processing, and reporting Candidates must ensure before applying that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply for. Refer to the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate in any discipline with proven computer proficiency
rows.desirable: Prior experience in academic or research project administration

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 18,000/- + HRA per month. The HRA rate is the rate for Kakinada City as per Govt. norms and is subject to change. All positions are purely temporary and coterminous with the project tenure. JNTUK also reserves the right to discontinue any position on administrative grounds or if the performance is not satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNTUK Administrative Assistant
content_sections.text: Fill the application form at the Google Form link given in the notice ( https://forms.gle/DmRUERMFNVR5SpA9A ). Attach a detailed CV, maximum 3 to 4 pages, specifying your qualifications and experience. Attach scanned copies of your experience certificate and marksheets from class X till date. Submit the application by 30-11-2026, 05:00 PM. For any queries, the notice asks candidates to send a mail to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the qualifications, experience and an in-person interview at JNTUK, Kakinada. Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail only, and the interview date will be notified to them by email. Candidates must bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) to the interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for an interview. Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail only. Originals of degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) must be brought to the interview.
